title: GHOST hub dashboard: choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the Living Figure Plate. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Living Figure Plate
options.lineage: Multi-panel journal figures (Nature/Science), with numbered references
options.thesis: The dashboard is a published figure that is still running: panels a–e, and every alert caption cites its references [E1].
options.viewport: Panel a, the floor plan as a measured figure with lit rooms and HOTARU's bearing line, beside panel b, breathing traces per room; the caption under it is the latest Nemotron explanation with [E#] links to a references list.
options.risk: Light 'paper' can read academic and quiet; it must stay alive with real-time traces and a severity band that is impossible to miss.

raised.raise: Panel f shows the raw 64-subcarrier CSI as a real barcode field per room, not decoration.
One accent is reserved for exactly one meaning: where GHOST's attention is now (the followed room, HOTARU's bearing).
Anomaly is a mark size on a fixed ramp, read without a legend.

options.label: Instrument Front Panel
options.thesis: GHOST as a four-channel scope: one graticule trace per room, softkeys for replay, the alert log as a measurement readout.
options.viewport: Four stacked channel traces with readouts (breaths/min, motion, jolt) and a floor-plan inset; alerts as triggered captures.
options.risk: Familiar: most sensing demos look like a scope, and dark-with-glow is a category default.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: The house as pure data: 64-subcarrier CSI as barcode columns, a sine lattice for breathing, inversion for alarm.
options.viewport: Four barcode fields, one per room, breathing drawn as a sine through each; an alert inverts the whole frame.
options.case: Fuses truthfully (CSI really is 64 bars a frame) and wins on wow for builders; loses on clarity for citations and severity without color.
options.risk: Strobing and pure B/W make long explanations and the timeline hard to read.

options.label: Dark Developer Console
options.thesis: Persistent graphite panels split by 1px seams; state colors come from syntax highlighting.
options.viewport: Tiled panels: plan, traces, routine, timeline, lamp; nothing moves but the panels' contents.
options.case: Holds clarity for an Operate tool; loses on identification: indistinguishable from any monitoring console.

options.label: Terminal Yellow Wayfinding
options.thesis: Yellow bands tell you where the person is and what HOTARU does next, one decision at a time.
options.viewport: A monumental yellow band: 'Bathroom · 9 min · checking in', the plan beneath.
options.case: Very clear about the next decision; loses on identification for a sensing/AI audience.
options.risk: Yellow everywhere fights the severity colours.

options.label: Star Atlas Plate
options.thesis: Rooms as constellations, presence as magnitude.
options.viewport: A night chart of the flat.
options.case: Fuses poorly: rooms are not stars.
options.kept: Hierarchy by mark size on a fixed ramp.

options.label: Vertical Feed
options.viewport: The latest alert fills the phone.
options.case: Loses the loop: you can't see sense, reason and act together.
options.kept: On a phone, the newest decision owns the first screen.

options.label: Acetate Tab Manual
options.thesis: Every panel a leaf over a coloured tab board.
options.viewport: The manual opened at the 3 am tab.
options.case: Loses both: a manual is static, GHOST is live.
options.kept: Changes snap in two steps; no decorative easing.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark monitoring dashboard of cards and charts, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Header with status, a card per room, a chart row, an alert list.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
